quote: first systematic study of word-representable graphs undertaken by Kitaev and Artem Pyatkin
note: Word-representable graphs were introduced by Sergey Kitaev in 2004. The first systematic study and development of the theory was undertaken in 2008 by Kitaev and Artem Pyatkin. The specific problem of which hard problems on graphs can be translated to words representing them and solved efficiently appears as an open problem within the field of word-representable graphs. While the exact year this specific problem was formally posed is not definitively documented in available sources, it emerged from the systematic study of the theory starting in 2008.
